doc.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024

title: Opening greetings and her Eastman job
summary: Rowe greets Jensen and confirms her post at Eastman, asking why she was hired.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and I’m at Hamilton College and I’m pleased to be speaking with Christine Jensen who is at Eastman. I want to congratulate you on your career thus far.
It’s an interesting read and listen. Now if I’m correct that your job description at Eastman is Assistant Professor of Jazz Studies and Contemporary Media. Is that right?
So this is maybe an odd question but why do you think the powers that be at Eastman hired you? Because I’m guessing that there were probably quite a few applicants.
